name: RSI Exhaustion Reclaim
thesis: Momentum extremes overshoot because trend-followers and forced liquidations pile into the same direction; the reclaim of an oversold or overbought threshold marks the point at which that flow is exhausted and reverses.
invalidation: Demote if win rate is below 40% over 15 trades or profit factor below 1.0 over 20.

provenance.note: Exact port of eval_rsi_extreme's crossing logic via prev(). Fires more often than the legacy family because this spec uses 30/70 thresholds while PARAM_DEFAULTS['rsi_extreme'] carries 25/75.
